en.headline: Driver arrested after crash into parked dump truck, nearly four times over alcohol limit
en.dek: A Volkswagen private car struck the rear of a stationary medium goods vehicle on On Sau Road in Sau Mau Ping late Thursday; the male driver recorded 109 microgrammes of alcohol per 100 millilitres of breath.
body: Police arrested a man for drink-driving after his silver Volkswagen private car crashed into the rear of a parked dump truck on On Sau Road in Sau Mau Ping around 11 p.m. on Thursday.

Officers said the car was travelling uphill near On Tai House and Maryknoll Secondary School when it lost control and slammed into the stationary truck, which had been parked since about 7 p.m. with no one inside. The front of the private car was severely damaged, with parts scattered on the road and airbags deployed. The driver sustained minor injuries.

A breath alcohol test conducted at the scene recorded 109 microgrammes per 100 millilitres of breath, nearly four times the legal limit of 22. Police arrested the man on suspicion of drink-driving. The case was taken up by the traffic investigation team.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪私家車撞停泊泥頭車 司機酒測超標近四倍被捕
zh.dek: 周四晚一輛福士私家車在安秀道失控撞向停泊泥頭車車尾，男司機酒精呼氣測試錄得109微克，超法定上限近四倍。
body: 警方拘捕一名男子，涉嫌酒後駕駛。周四晚上約11時，一輛銀色福士私家車沿安秀道上斜行駛，至安泰樓及瑪利諾中學對開時懷疑失控，撞向一輛停泊路旁、車上無人的泥頭車車尾。
私家車車頭嚴重損毀，零件散落一地，安全氣袋彈出。男司機受輕傷。涉事泥頭車約晚上7時已停泊該處。
警員為司機進行酒精呼氣測試，結果達109微克，較法定上限22微克高出近四倍。警方以涉嫌酒後駕駛將他拘捕，案件交由交通部跟進。
